screen.aeroscapes_preflight.title: Preflight information
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.timeout: No reading received. Board an assembled ship and refresh.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.aboard: Board an assembled ship or sit in its seat, then refresh. The screen reads the ship you are aboard.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.sample: Snapshot: %s s ago. This screen does not pause the world.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.stale: OLD SNAPSHOT (%s s). Refresh before using these readings; the ship may have changed or you may have left it.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.support: Balloon support at the snapshot's air pressure: %s kg
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.margin: Balloon support minus measured mass: %s kg
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.assessment.i: No current support assessment: the snapshot is old, the reading is incomplete, or gravity is unsuitable for this comparison.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.assessment.l: An envelope is leaking. Present support can fall as gas escapes.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.assessment.n: No valid balloon found. Propeller lift and other forms of support are not assessed.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.assessment.b: Balloon support alone is below measured mass. Propellers or other support may still contribute.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.assessment.c: Recorded balloon support covers measured mass. This is a mass comparison, not a guarantee of safe flight.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.target: Target gas volume: %s m³; current change: %s m³/tick
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.no_leak: No envelope leak reported in the inspected balloons.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.infinite: current fuel has no burn countdown
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.no_portable: No Create Simulated portable engine was found in the inspected bodies.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.fuel_scope: Fuel readings cover Create Simulated portable-engine slots and their current burn only. Other engines, tanks, external feeds and stored fuel elsewhere are not included; no flight time or range is predicted.
screen.aeroscapes_preflight.limits: Sable mass includes assembled blocks and attached contraptions, not every inventory item. This screen does not assess propeller lift, anchors, stability or steering. Scroll to read all entries.
